title: Text-to-Image Prompt Optimization for Unseen Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2506.16853v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) prompt optimization rewrites user prompts to improve the quality of generated images under a target reward. Existing methods typically assume a known reward, relying on reward-specific training or handcrafted instructions. We instead study prompt optimization for unseen rewards, which are unknown at design time and accessible only through scores at test time. We observe that removing reward-specific guidance substantially reduces the search efficiency of LLM-based optimizers, even though their optimization histories contain evidence of what the reward favors. To address this challenge, we introduce RATTPO (Reward-Adaptive Test-Time Prompt Optimization), a reward-generic method that turns this implicit evidence into explicit search guidance. translated_title: 面向未见奖励的文生图提示词优化
translated_abstract: 文生图（T2I）提示词优化通过重写用户提示词，在目标奖励下提升生成图像的质量。现有方法通常假设奖励是已知的，依赖于针对特定奖励的训练或手工设计的指令。我们则研究针对未见奖励的提示词优化，这类奖励在设计阶段是未知的，仅在测试阶段可以通过评分访问。我们观察到，移除奖励特定的指导会显著降低基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化器的搜索效率，即使它们的优化历史中包含着奖励所偏好内容的证据。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了RATTPO（奖励自适应测试时提示词优化），这是一种奖励无关的通用方法，能够将这些隐式证据转化为显式的搜索指导。在每一轮优化中，RATTPO通过对比高分与低分提示词，推断出关于有前景重写方向的相互竞争的假设，进而生成并评估候选提示词。
tldr: 提出RATTPO方法，通过对比高分与低分提示词，将优化历史中的隐式证据转化为显式搜索指导，从而实现对设计时未知奖励的文生图提示词优化。
en_tdlr: RATTPO enables text-to-image prompt optimization for unseen rewards by contrasting high- and low-scoring prompts to convert implicit evidence from optimization histories into explicit search guidance.
